## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added Fjall as a configurable backend for persistent state storage, providing an alternative to LMDB.

* **Chores**
  * Added database-fjall workspace package with Fjall database integration.
  * Updated build configuration and dependencies to support Fjall backend selection.
  * Extended test coverage for new state persistence implementations.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

This PR introduces a new Fjall-backed persistent database package (`@typeberry/database-fjall`) that implements HybridSerializedStates for in-memory state leafs with disk-persisted large values. HybridWorkerConfig is refactored to an async factory to support selecting LMDB vs Fjall hybrid backends. mainImporter and mainFuzz are updated to accept "lmdb-hybrid" and "fjall-hybrid" modes, with fuzzing defaulting to "fjall-hybrid" via JAM_FUZZ_DB.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes

## Possibly related PRs

- [FluffyLabs/typeberry#979](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/979): Introduces the original LMDB-based HybridSerializedStates and HybridWorkerConfig pattern that this PR extends to support Fjall as an alternative backend.  
- [FluffyLabs/typeberry#965](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/965): Changes to main-fuzz and fuzzing entrypoints related to persistent fuzz DB selection and behavior.  
- [FluffyLabs/typeberry#1001](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/1001): Related work touching disk sizing and ImporterStats integrations for persistent state stores.

## Poem

> I nibble bytes and store them well,  
> In leaves that dance and fjalls that dwell,  
> I hop from RAM and sink to disk,  
> My whiskers code — a tidy trick! 🐇✨
